summary: The connector J1 is unseated. The continuity check on NET_A failed, which proves the open. Reseat the plug. The mounting bracket BRKT1 is missing from the scan and can be printed.
confidence_statement: Proven by the meter: NET_A is open at J1. Suspected only: nothing else. Not inspected: the inside of the switch housing.

evidence_summary: housing gap ~2 mm at J1 (still s7)
no continuity J1.1 to LOAD1.1 with power off

safety: Unplug the power adapter before you start.
This product has no large capacitors or lithium cells; still, never probe with power on unless a step says so.
Never identify + and - by wire colour. If a step connects a supply, measure polarity with the meter first.

reasons: protective part: trip time, I2t and breaking capacity not confirmed

steps.text: Push the J1 plug (AR label: J1 plug) firmly onto its header until the latch clicks.
Re-run the continuity check between the J1 plug's left pin and the red LOAD1 terminal. Expect a beep.
Print BRKT1 (its node in the model's STEP file) and fit it to the housing.
Plug the adapter back in and switch on. The product should run.

confirm.expected: NET_A reads continuity; rescan shows BRKT1 ok

disagreements: Grain diagnose called J1 ok (connector gap is below LiDAR resolution); our close-up and the meter say otherwise.
